elements.element: Cap is mutual (applies to each Party)
elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability ... The cap is mutual"

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim" — uses 'all amounts' rather than fees, and an event anchor rather than the claim

elements.element: Cap expressed as the greater of the two limbs
elements.evidence: "shall not exceed the greater of (a) ... and (b) USD 1,000,000"
No exclusion of indirect or consequential damages appears in 21.1 or the resolved definitions; the redline adds none

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality
elements.evidence: Excluded Claims: "a Party's breach of confidentiality"; 21.1 "Except for Excluded Claims"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other Party's IP
elements.evidence: Excluded Claims: "infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages" — limited to undisputed defined 'Fees' (the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) for conforming Services, not payment obligations generally

"each Party's total aggregate liability ... shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event ..."; "The cap is mutual"

reasons: The locked preferred level is not fully achieved: the fee limb reads "all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms" anchored to "the event giving rise to the claim", not the playbook's "fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim".
No mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages is inserted anywhere in the operative text, so that preferred element remains open.

The 'payment obligations are not damages' carve-out remains narrow — "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" (and 'Fees' is only the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) — rather than Customer's payment obligations or all amounts due generally.

The result nonetheless clears the fallback comfortably (mutual 12-month cap plus USD 1,000,000 floor, with indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct carve-outs), so the clause is acceptable at the fallback and the residual gaps are rationale notes.
The single replace operation is surgical — it changes only the cap basis sentence and introduces no undefined terms or dangling mechanics, so minimality and intent preservation hold.
